title: Architecture Decision Record (Nygard-style skeleton with frontmatter)

consequences.description: spec-detail (2026-07-09): Nygard's symmetric positive/negative/neutral triplet (adr-20260709-adr-consequences-tripolar). During the dual-format period, also accept the array form used by existing ADRs from before spec-detail. Enforce the triplet forward-only and touched-only (required for records created on/after 2026-07-09); strict enforcement is handled by docs/scripts/schema_validate.py. Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §18.

oneOf.description: Legacy array form for backward compatibility with ADRs from before spec-detail (FR-008).
Tripolar form, required for new ADRs created on/after 2026-07-09.

negative.description: Undesirable consequences of adoption; empty violates Nygard's symmetry rule.

neutral.description: Neutral consequences of adoption (secondary effects, interactions or preserved assumptions).

confirmation.description: Optional field derived from MADR. Declares a mechanical way to verify that this decision is upheld (fitness function, grep or test). Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §18.

decision_bindings.description: Project-root-relative files that enforce this decision at runtime. For an accepted ADR, each file must identify the ADR ID as decision_ref or in a comment, and also appear in source_paths.
